documents.title: The Rooms Driving the Economy
documents.summary: 巴尔金认为当前通胀顽固偏高，若经济延续现有路径，风险更偏向通胀一侧；同时主张谨慎调整政策，未明确给出加息幅度。
documents.note: 纳入：本人当前通胀判断及条件性通胀风险；引言与正文同义不重复计入。政策方向“straightforward”未明说加息，不据此补+3。

evidence.text: What we have seen is stubbornly elevated inflation.
evidence.label: 通胀压力仍高
evidence.reason: 明确本人当前总体通胀判断，正文与引言同一主张只计一次。

evidence.text: Should the economy remain on its current path, the risk lies on the inflation side of our dual mandate.
evidence.label: 通胀压力仍高
evidence.reason: 与当前通胀水平不同，说明展望中的上行风险；Should构成条件，按1×0.5。

documents.title: Reserve Currencies and Stablecoins
documents.summary: 哈马克预计货币政策需要转向限制性立场，以及时将通胀拉回2%；当前通胀高于目标且供需两侧压力较广泛。
documents.note: 纳入：有明确当前转向限制性政策主张；汇率、瑞士央行、稳定币及历史美元地位不参与。

evidence.text: I expect that monetary policy will need to move to a restrictive stance to bring inflation back to 2 percent in a timely manner.
evidence.label: 政策需要收紧
evidence.reason: 明确本人当前基准政策立场；不是过去会议，也不是条件式。

evidence.text: Those readings are well above our 2 percent goal and higher than at the start of this year.
evidence.label: 通胀压力仍高
evidence.reason: 紧接9月总体/核心PCE读数，明确当前通胀水平过高且比年初上升。

evidence.text: Inflation has now been above our goal for nearly six years, and the pressures I’m seeing appear to be relatively broad based, reflecting both supply and demand.
evidence.label: 通胀压力仍高
evidence.reason: 独立信息是本人看到当前通胀压力较广泛并兼具供需来源；与单纯当期水平区分。

documents.title: Opening remarks for moderated conversation at Voices of the Eleventh District
documents.summary: 洛根认为当前政策缺乏限制，目标利率还需上调至少50个基点；虽通胀有所下降，趋势仍高于2%且可能持续。
documents.note: 纳入：当前明确还需上调目标区间至少50bp；历史9月已加息不计；再次主张成为限制性政策与50bp重复不复计。

evidence.text: Still, I currently estimate the target range needs to rise an additional 50 basis points or more to appropriately balance the outlook and risks for our dual mandate goals.
evidence.label: 支持进一步加息
evidence.reason: 本人明确当前目标区间还需上调至少50bp；与后文tighter/become restrictive同一政策主张不再计。

evidence.text: But it is trending toward the mid-2’s, not all the way to the FOMC’s 2 percent goal.
evidence.label: 通胀压力仍高
evidence.reason: 前句明确it指inflation；虽通胀下降，但本人判断其趋势仍高于目标。

evidence.text: Without any policy restriction, inflation will likely continue its above-target trend.
evidence.label: 通胀压力仍高
evidence.reason: 前文已判断当前缺乏限制；这句是通胀超目标持续的基准预测，区别于当前趋势水平。不是额外再计收紧政策。

documents.title: A Long-Term View on the Costs of Shelter
documents.summary: 巴尔认为当前通胀高于目标、回落不足，通胀风险上升而就业风险减轻；预计可能仍需政策调整，但未明确下一步方向或幅度。
documents.note: 纳入：当前通胀过高/回目标不足及通胀风险上升；上周加息是历史事实。进一步policy adjustments未明确方向，延续9/29同一保守口径，不加+3。

evidence.text: Economic growth is strong and the labor market is solid, but inflation is above our 2 percent target and not clearly trending toward target in a timely way.
evidence.label: 通胀压力仍高
evidence.reason: 明确当前总体通胀偏高且回归不足。

evidence.text: Moreover, risks to achieving our inflation target have increased, while risks to the labor market have receded.
evidence.label: 通胀压力仍高
evidence.reason: 上下文明确是高通胀背景的通胀风险增加；区别于当前水平。不得把就业风险减轻反当就业下行风险。
